svg.title: Coordinator endings cluster in a narrow time band
svg.desc: End the eleven lanes within the narrow time band while other lanes continue below. Simultaneity is visible; no hand, blast or shared cause connector explains it.

**Action:** A large fraction of runs stop around the same time; the classifier-identified coordinator set is gone by early morning.
